purpose: Record the two host units packet 139 retired, what each claimed, what replaces it, and the probe that makes the retirement a result rather than a preference.

authority.requirement: tr_tss and the 130/134-bound tests are fixed or retired, with a coverage mapping

why_retired: It cannot be linked. It defines four of the nine host-seam symbols itself (gtos_gdt_host_str_selector, _sgdt_base, _sgdt_limit, _reads), which 137 moved into tests/gdt_host_seam.cpp so that more than one unit could link the observation. Linking it without that unit leaves five symbols undefined; linking it with that unit defines four of them twice. Both link attempts exit 1; the probe records the exact diagnostics.

Its eleven assertions are all of the form bad > 0: a mutation is applied and the case requires that something was refused. None of them requires that the refusal was the right one, so a case could pass on an unrelated gate. safe_tss_test.cpp already covers every one of these mutations and requires the named reason for each.
It asserts nothing about the busy bit at all, which is the one obligation its structure could not see.

coverage_mapping.tr_tss claim: a task register selector that is not the loaded one is refused
coverage_mapping.safe_tss case: a well-formed selector that is not the loaded one is refused -> the task register selector is not the one that was loaded

coverage_mapping.tr_tss claim: a task register selector with a non-zero RPL is refused
coverage_mapping.safe_tss case: a selector with a non-zero RPL is refused -> the task register selector has a ring other than 0

coverage_mapping.tr_tss claim: a descriptor outside the GDT limit is refused
coverage_mapping.safe_tss case: a descriptor past the GDT limit is refused -> the descriptor is not inside the GDT limit

coverage_mapping.tr_tss claim: an absent TSS descriptor is refused
coverage_mapping.safe_tss case: an absent descriptor is refused -> the TSS descriptor is not present

coverage_mapping.tr_tss claim: a descriptor that is not a TSS is refused
coverage_mapping.safe_tss case: a non-system descriptor is refused -> the descriptor is not a system descriptor, plus the 16-bit TSS and LDT cases -> the TSS descriptor type is not a 32-bit TSS

coverage_mapping.tr_tss claim: a TSS base that is not the runtime task state is refused
coverage_mapping.safe_tss case: a base outside the declared window is refused without reading it, and a base inside the window that is not the task state is refused

coverage_mapping.tr_tss claim: a TSS ring-0 selector that is not the runtime's is refused
coverage_mapping.safe_tss case: a TSS ring-0 selector that is not the runtime's is refused -> the TSS ring-0 stack selector is not the one the runtime set

coverage_mapping.tr_tss claim: a TSS io map base that is not the runtime's is refused
coverage_mapping.safe_tss case: a TSS io map base that is not the runtime's is refused -> the TSS io map base is not the one the runtime set

coverage_mapping.tr_tss claim: a TSS limit that is not the task state size is refused
coverage_mapping.safe_tss case: a descriptor limit that is not the task state size is refused -> the TSS descriptor limit is not the task state size

coverage_added_beyond_tr_tss: the normal case, with the byte counts asserted so a counter that never increments cannot make a refusal look clean
the absence of reads before a refusal, attributed per region
the two disagreements between the descriptor's busy bit and the task register, which tr_tss never touched
several faults at once, requiring the earlier gate to win by name
retired.evidence: test-only/tr-tss-probe-02: compile rc=0, link A rc=1 (five undefined seam symbols), link B rc=1 (four multiple definitions), verdict RETIRE

retired.why: It is the replacement, and it was itself wrong: its production-descriptor case asserted (AccessAt & 0x89) == 0x89, which is only true before ltr runs. It now models both worlds through the seam's gtos_gdt_host_ltr_ran and requires the observation to accept the pair and refuse each disagreement.
retired.evidence: test-only/safe-tss-06: SAFE TSS UNIT PASS, with 'busy after ltr -> accepted, busy 00000001 type 0000008B' matching the 0x8B the guest printed in test-only/h-run-03

the_130_and_134_bound_tests.claim_to_check: the packet brief names tests bound to packets 130 and 134 as candidates for the same treatment
the_130_and_134_bound_tests.finding: no unit in tests/ carries a packet number, and the 130/134 obligations that exist are scene obligations in tools/scene-admission.mjs, which this packet re-derived from the guest's own output rather than inheriting
the_130_and_134_bound_tests.action: no file retired on this ground, because no file was found whose retirement this evidence would justify; the scene obligations those packets introduced are covered by the matrix rows and by tools/verify-matrix-139.mjs, which restates each scene's obligations independently of the declaration it is checking
the_130_and_134_bound_tests.note: recorded as a finding rather than left silent: a retirement carried out to satisfy a phrase in a brief, without a probe like the one above, would be exactly the kind of unearned closure this packet exists to refuse
